# Watertable

> Brand and website systems for local businesses. Watertable helps businesses reach the demand already searching for them: a clear brand, story-driven messaging, and a website engineered to convert, found by search engines and AI assistants alike.

## What Watertable does

- Brand strategy and identity: logo refinement, color and typography systems, brand guides.
- StoryBrand messaging: clear, customer-focused copy built on a proven framework.
- Website design and build: modern, fast, mobile-responsive sites focused on converting visitors into calls.
- Online footprint and AI visibility: auditing and fixing inconsistent business information across the web so search engines and AI tools trust and recommend the business.

## Who it serves

Local service businesses and small businesses, with roots in the Southern California market.

## Packages

- Brand Foundation: market research and brand identity system.
- Brand + Convert: full brand, online footprint fix, and a converting website.
- Complete Launch: the full build with lead capture and post-launch support.
- Care Plan: optional monthly hosting, security, and updates.
